Chapter 712: Chapter 14: The Theory of Heaven’s Gate (Please Subscribe)_2

Lin Yuan was unaware of what conditions were needed to leave this two-dimensional world.

But improving his strength was definitely the right approach.

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path is inherently good at strengthening the body, it’s just that in this two-dimensional world, the way to enhance the body is starkly different from that in the Main Universe.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Ever since the Perfect Time Being created ‘Low-dimensional Space,’ such ‘spaces’ have been widely spread for use in leisure or gambling competitions to test ‘Understanding.’

Since the lives in ‘Low-dimensional Space’ find most of their usual cultivation methods useless, if they wish to grow stronger, they must start from scratch and create new cultivation methods suited for this ‘Low-dimensional Space.’

...

“I have Against-Heaven’s Understanding, so creating a cultivation method that suits this world isn’t difficult,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

However, he didn’t underestimate the thoughts of other powerhouses who fell into this two-dimensional world.

Especially those Eleventh-Rank Lives, on the same level, Lin Yuan believed that no one could match his understanding.

But when compared with higher-level lives… under the perspective of looking down from a great height, the gap was bound to shrink.

Moreover, having lost the support of the powers of rules, the upper limit of this two-dimensional world was inevitably not high.

“Take it slow.”

Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts.

Since he had fallen into this two-dimensional world, he could only take one step at a time.

“Let’s see what’s outside the room,” Lin Yuan steadied his mind and stood up to push open the wooden door.

Outside the door was lush greenery, and at a distance, there was a stream. A dark-skinned middle-aged man was fishing by the stream.

“Wa ka ka.”

Upon seeing Lin Yuan walk out of the room, the middle-aged man immediately came over with big strides, speaking in a language Lin Yuan couldn’t understand.

“A completely new language?”

Lin Yuan listened carefully and observed the middle-aged man’s facial expressions with each intonation he uttered.

After a brief pause, he tried speaking a few sentences tentatively, and continued to watch the middle-aged man’s reaction. After three or four minutes, he was more or less able to communicate normally with the middle-aged man.

Although everything about Lin Yuan was suppressed in this two-dimensional world, his original self located in the Main Universe could share memories.

With the ‘thinking speed’ of a Tenth Rank Life, and combined with Against-Heaven’s Understanding, learning the language of this world was child’s play for Lin Yuan.

In fact, if he wasn’t in this two-dimensional world, Lin Yuan could completely read the middle-aged man’s every memory silently, a method far more efficient than the current way of language interaction.

“Are you saying that two days ago, countless ‘meteors’ fell from the sky, and as it happened, one ‘meteor’ landed nearby, which you went to find, and then you found me?”

After conversing with the middle-aged man for a while, Lin Yuan appeared to be in deep thought.

The so-called ‘meteors’ should be the same as him, the powerhouses drawn into the battlefield within White Paper.

After a while,

By continuously guiding the middle-aged man, Lin Yuan roughly obtained basic information about this two-dimensional world.

From the middle-aged man’s perspective, he lived on a vast and boundless continent.

This continent’s lifestyle was very primitive, with most people gathering in the form of tribes.

Occasionally there were some cities, and cities were indeed very powerful forces, supposedly with great ‘Witch Kings’ in charge.

‘Witch Kings’ were the strongest entities the middle-aged man knew of, able to easily move mountains and split rocks, infinitely terrifying.

“My luck isn’t too bad.”

Lin Yuan glanced at the middle-aged man and thought to himself.

At least the middle-aged man didn’t harbor any malicious intentions when he found him.

Given the information Lin Yuan had just received from Xia Qin Supreme Being, many powerhouses had found themselves in dire straits after falling into this two-dimensional world.

Some powerhouses were unfortunate enough to fall into hands of the Cannibal Tribe, where they were directly hung on a roasting spit.

To know, Ninth Rank, Tenth Rank, and Eleventh Rank powerhouses, the moment they fell into this world, all their powers and methods were dimensionally reduced and couldn’t be used, rendering them no different from ordinary people in this two-dimensional world.

The only thing unchanged was their memory.

But relying on memory alone was of no use, especially when encountering those Cannibal Tribes. With no common language, their fate was predictable.

Some of the powerhouses who ended up in the hands of the Cannibal Tribes, unable to bear the humiliation, chose to self-destruct or eradicate the consciousness that had fallen into this two-dimensional world.

Then, there came the discovery that ‘death in the avatar of this two-dimensional world would result in a fundamental loss.’

Beyond ending up in the Cannibal Tribes, some fell directly into nests of ferocious beasts and were promptly devoured.

Still, some landed in prosperous cities, astonishing some native powerhouses, who then captured them to study slowly.

In any case, according to what Lin Yuan knew, a significant portion of the powerhouses who fell into this two-dimensional world were not in good situations.

Of course, there were also those who were in good situations, such as being treated as ‘sacred’ beings descended from heaven by some tribal forces, or being valued by native powerhouses, and so forth.

Lin Yuan’s situation was not particularly good, but it was not bad either; at least he was quite satisfied.

“Pado, where is the nearest gathering place?” Lin Yuan looked at the honest middle-aged man before him.

From their conversation, Lin Yuan knew that the man’s name was ‘Pado,’ and he lived by fishing and hunting. After finding Lin Yuan, he had brought him back home.

“That direction,” Pado pointed in a certain direction, “but it’s better to wait for others if you want to go there. Otherwise, encountering a ferocious beast on the way could be deadly.”

There were other natives living around Pado’s dwelling, totaling about dozens of people.

On this continent, all sorts of ferocious beasts were rampant, and humans in this world could only survive by sticking together.
